9,779 people rated this 4.3 stars. Most tourists still skip it.

Phu Quoc Prison History Museum is the island's most confronting stop. French colonial-era cages. Mannequins frozen mid-torture. Real history that doesn't sanitize itself.

This isn't comfortable. It's not supposed to be. But leaving Phu Quoc without seeing this means leaving with only half the story.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking through cells where POWs were kept during the Vietnam War. The mannequins are graphic. The history is real. Address: 350 Đ. Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Phú Quốc.
